headline: Vantage Metals cuts guidance after margin squeeze
body: Vantage Metals lowered full-year guidance, citing margin pressure from raw material costs and weaker pricing power.

headline: Vantage Metals appoints new regional sales director
body: Vantage Metals announced a leadership appointment in its sales organization. The company said the change is part of a planned succession.

headline: Vantage Metals opens new production line in Austin
body: Vantage Metals commissioned a new line at its Austin site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Vantage Metals publishes annual sustainability report
body: Vantage Metals released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Vantage Metals wins quality award from industry association
body: Vantage Metals received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Analysts trim outlook for Vantage Metals on softer demand
body: Two analysts lowered their outlook for Vantage Metals, citing softer demand and rising input costs. No change to guidance has been announced.

headline: Vantage Metals announces layoffs affecting 24% of workforce
body: Vantage Metals said it will cut 24% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.
